bullets.text: first of october. the air finally has edges. wearing socks indoors like it was my idea.
duck at okunoin, clear sky, leaf glyph. carried a line about gurus arranging the right situation. the cedars arranged nothing. shade happened anyway.
flipping the wall calendar. september's photo was a lighthouse. october's is a lighthouse too. different lighthouse, allegedly.
a spider rebuilt its web across the same doorway i walk through every morning. one of us is going to have to compromise.
